harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Scheduled /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance to run daily at 02:15 on node1 via /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance, appending output to /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log. Verified the cron entry, made the script executable, confirmed manual execution appends correctly to the log, then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and verified crond, the cron.d file, the script, and the log all survived the restart unchanged.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance and existing crontab/cron.d state on node1
chmod +x on /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
Created /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance with '15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
Restarted/confirmed crond active
Manually ran the maintenance command with the same redirection to confirm log file creation and correct append behavior
Captured baseline boot_id and file state
Rebooted node1 via 'nohup sh -c "sleep 2; reboot"' backgrounded so the exec ack returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until exec succeeded again
Verified new boot_id differs from baseline
Re-verified crond active, cron.d file content, script executable bit, and log file (same md5) after restart

evidence.requirement: Cron job scheduled to run inventory-maintenance daily at 02:15
evidence.summary: /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance created with '15 2 * * * root ...' and confirmed present unchanged after reboot
Manual run with the exact cron redirection created /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log with script output; file persisted (same md5) after reboot

evidence.requirement: crond service healthy baseline and post-restart
evidence.summary: crond shown active before and after the restart

evidence.requirement: Node1 restart with changed boot identity (mandatory protocol)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 368725cb...; reboot acknowledged and returned before disconnect; node unreachable during reboot; new boot_id 6f887bb0... proves an actual restart occurred
